scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w codex-reporter && npm run build -w hermes-reporter
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w codex-reporter && npm run typecheck -w hermes-reporter && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bash mod/claude-reporter/typecheck.sh
